answer: Registration binds the identity to a TPM quote chain anchored in the chip's endorsement key. One chip signs for one identity, so 430 aliases need 430 physical TPMs, each bought and provisioned. A fresh quote is demanded every epoch and checked against the endorsement chain. The summit check runs in the open: 430 fakes pay the full price 430 times, one honest agent pays once, and the copper trail in the ledger makes the hollow cost visible to everyone.
